stories.title: Romaria de Nossa Senhora Aparecida em Ribeirão Preto, SP, reúne milhares; veja fotos

en.title: Pilgrimage of Our Lady of Aparecida in Ribeirão Preto, SP, brings together thousands; see photos
en.summary: Thousands of faithful participated in a pilgrimage in Ribeirão Preto, walking 12 kilometers to a parish in Bonfim Paulista where a field mass was celebrated in honor of Our Lady of Aparecida.

stories.title: Nobel 2026: veja quem são os vencedores das seis categorias do prêmio

en.title: Nobel 2026: see who are the winners of the six categories of the prize
en.summary: American economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for developing models that help governments and central banks address economic crises and inflation control.

stories.title: Área técnica do TSE não encontra fake news em canal ‘Exército do Lula’, mas aponta riscos eleitorais

en.title: TSE's technical area does not find fake news in 'Exército do Lula' channel, but points out electoral risks
en.summary: Brazil's Electoral Justice technical team found no misinformation in the 'Exército do Lula' channel while identifying potential electoral risks associated with the platform.

stories.title: Jovem morto pela PM com 27 tiros é velado em SP

en.title: Young man killed by police with 27 shots is laid to rest in São Paulo
en.summary: Gustavo Munis de Santana, 20, was fatally shot by military police early Saturday with 27 rounds in São Paulo's southern zone. Officers claimed they mistook his mobile phone for a weapon.

stories.title: Kassio receberá equipes jurídicas das campanhas após Lula questionar decisões do TSE favoráveis a Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Kassio will receive legal teams from campaigns after Lula questions TSE decisions favorable to Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: The TSE president scheduled a meeting with legal representatives from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaigns following the PT's objections to electoral court rulings benefiting the PL candidate.

stories.title: Moraes autoriza Flávio Bolsonaro a visitar o pai, preso em casa

en.title: Moraes authorizes Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, held under house arrest
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes permitted senator Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest. Flávio's visits had been prohibited since July when he shared a letter from his father endorsing his presidential candidacy.

stories.title: Nunes Marques determina análise de canal ‘Exército do Lula’ após guerra de decisões no TSE

en.title: Nunes Marques orders analysis of 'Lula's Army' channel following dispute over TSE decisions
en.summary: The TSE president directed an examination of the 'Exército do Lula' channel amid conflicting electoral court rulings.

stories.title: Moraes autoriza Flávio Bolsonaro a retomar visitas ao pai e mantém veto a declarações políticas

en.title: Moraes authorizes Flávio Bolsonaro to resume visits to father and maintains ban on political statements
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes permitted Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to resume visits to former president Jair Bolsonaro after a prohibition that had been in place since July. Political statements remain restricted.

stories.title: Moraes libera visitas de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro após 90 dias de proibição

en.title: Moraes permits Flávio's visits to Jair Bolsonaro after 90 days of prohibition
en.summary: A ban preventing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting former president Jair Bolsonaro was lifted after 90 days.

stories.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida: 95 anos da padroeira do Brasil; entenda

en.title: Our Lady of Aparecida: 95 years of Brazil's patroness; understand
en.summary: In 1717, fishermen discovered a clay image of the Virgin Mary in the Paraíba do Sul River in São Paulo state, which became known as Nossa Senhora Aparecida and attracted devotion across Brazil.

stories.title: Equipe técnica do TSE não encontra fake news no canal 'Exército do Lula'

en.title: TSE technical team finds no fake news in 'Exército do Lula' channel
en.summary: A technical report by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court found no false information supporting Lula or opposing Flávio Bolsonaro in the WhatsApp channel "Exército do Lula".

stories.title: Para ministros, decisão de Nunes Marques sobre canal de Lula é ‘incomum’ e gera desconfiança no TSE

en.title: For ministers, Nunes Marques' decision on Lula's channel is 'unusual' and generates distrust in TSE
en.summary: Electoral court ministers called President Kassio Nunes Marques' suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel unusual after a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. The suspension was overturned the same day by another court official.

stories.title: TSE diz não ter identificado fake news apontadas por Flávio Bolsonaro no canal 'Exército do Lula'

en.title: TSE says it did not identify fake news pointed out by Flávio Bolsonaro in 'Exército do Lula' channel
en.summary: The electoral court's disinformation unit found no fake news in the 'Exército do Lula' channel during its examined period, though it noted some content may have been deleted.

stories.title: Após questionamento, Justiça da Inglaterra mantém escritório de vítimas do desastre em Mariana

en.title: After questioning, England's courts maintain law office for Mariana disaster victims
en.summary: England's High Court ruled that a committee representing plaintiffs in the Samarco dam disaster case cannot replace the law firm handling the case in English courts.

stories.title: Arábia Saudita enfrenta novos ataques com mísseis e drones

en.title: Saudi Arabia faces new attacks with missiles and drones
en.summary: Saudi Arabia reported a new wave of missile and drone attacks, with Riyadh airport remaining closed following a weekend attack claimed by Houthi militants from Yemen.

stories.title: Lula diz que oposição quer decidir sobre 6x1 após as eleições para ter 'coragem de votar contra'

en.title: Lula says opposition wants to decide on 6x1 after elections to have 'courage to vote against'
en.summary: President Lula stated he believes the Senate opposition fears voting against a constitutional amendment to end the 6x1 work schedule and is delaying the vote until after elections. He expressed confidence the measure will be approved.
